title: Jump Blues
style: Swinging 160 BPM jump blues, honking sax section, walking upright slap, boogie-woogie piano, shiny archtop chops, brass punches, crowd-shout hooks, dance-floor fire.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Woke up broke, rain on my shoes
Boss man hollered with the bad-news blues.
I grabbed my coat and a half-shot grin
Said “Trouble can’t catch what the groove lets in!”
[Chorus]
I’m gonna jump, jump, jumpstart the blues
Kick off the sorrow in my dancing shoes.
When the horn section hits, my worries refuse—
I jump, jump, jumpstart the blues.
[Verse 2]
Corner joint buzzing like a beehive coil
Sax keeps screaming, “Set your soul on boil!”
Quarter in the juke, hardwood scream and shout
My baby’s swinging low while the brass lays out.
[Chorus]
I’m gonna jump, jump, jumpstart the blues
Kick off the sorrow in my dancing shoes.
When the horn section hits, my worries refuse—
I jump, jump, jumpstart the blues.
[Bridge]
Piano runs wild like a freight-train line
Sweat flies holy, feelin’ mighty fine.
If pain comes knocking, I’ll swing that door—
Ain’t got no time, we’re jumping the floor!
[Chorus – double]
Jump, jump, jumpstart the blues
Kick off the sorrow in my dancing shoes.
When the horn section hits, my worries refuse—
I jump, jump, jumpstart the blues.
Jump, jump, jumpstart the blues
Kick off the sorrow in my dancing shoes.
When the horn section hits, my worries refuse—
I jump, jump, jumpstart the blues.
[Outro]
So when your heart feels heavy, just syncopate your stride
Let the bass walk cooler than your troubles can ride.
We’ll keep this joint rocking till the dawn breaks through—
Jump, jump, jumpstart the blues!
